description: This PHP file defines the 'javascript' class responsible for generating client-side JavaScript validation code for form fields within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM framework. It includes methods to add validation rules for various field types, manage validation scripts, and interface with form elements in the application.

classes.name: javascript
classes.description: Class for generating JavaScript validation scripts for form fields within SuiteCRM modules, supporting various types of validation, field handling, and script generation.

methods.name: setFormName
methods.description: Sets the HTML form name for validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the javascript class, setting up the default sugarbean object.

methods.name: setSugarBean
methods.description: Assigns a specific sugarbean object to be used for validation context.

methods.name: addRequiredFields
methods.description: Adds JavaScript validation rules for all required fields in the current sugarbean.

methods.name: addSpecialField
methods.description: Adds validation rules for a specialized field, such as date fields.

methods.name: addField
methods.description: Adds validation rules for a specific field, with support for translation and validation types.

methods.name: stripEndColon
methods.description: Removes trailing colons from display names.

methods.name: addFieldGeneric
methods.description: Generates a validation script line for a general field.

methods.name: addFieldCallback
methods.description: Adds a callback-based validation rule.

methods.name: addFieldRange
methods.description: Adds range-based validation for a field.

methods.name: addFieldIsValidDate
methods.description: Adds date validity validation.

methods.name: addFieldIsValidTime
methods.description: Adds time validity validation.

methods.name: addFieldDateBefore
methods.description: Adds validation to ensure a date precedes another.

methods.name: addFieldDateBeforeAllowBlank
methods.description: Adds date before validation with optional blank allowance.

methods.name: addToValidateBinaryDependency
methods.description: Validates dependency between two binary fields.

methods.name: addToValidateComparison
methods.description: Validates comparison between two fields.

methods.name: addFieldIsInArray
methods.description: Validates that a field's value is within an array.

methods.name: addAllFields
methods.description: Adds validation rules for all fields in the current sugarbean, with options to skip specific fields and translate labels.

methods.name: addActionMenu
methods.description: Includes script to initialize an action menu.

methods.name: getScript
methods.description: Retrieves the assembled JavaScript validation script, optionally wrapping with script tags and clearing previous validation entries.

methods.name: buildStringToTranslateInSmarty
methods.description: Prepares a display string for translation in Smarty templates.

methods.name: getRequiredString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of whether a field is required ('true' or 'false').
